author: Matt Wolfe
description:
#ad I used @GensparkProduct Design to generate the UI for a FutureTools app... and it only took me about 30 minutes.

It created the home feed, individual tool pages, and a layered, fully editable design. I could even generate a launch video in the same visual style, share the project with my team, and bring it into Genspark Code to start turning it into a working product.

If you want to check out all their design templates, or start one from scratch, sign up and get free credits at the link in the pinned comment. 

#Genspark #GensparkDesign #WorkwithGenspark #AI #AITools
title: This AI Design Hack Saved Me HOURS
